what: the first DSA attention layer's complete attention sublayer on 32 tokens, from the model-author implementation

recorded_as.note: the recording's original container; its tensors are carried here byte for byte

encoding: tensors.<name>.base64 is the tensor's raw bytes in little-endian order, base64-encoded, with its dtype and shape beside it; tensors.<name>.sha256 is the SHA-256 of those bytes. attention-numerics.md shows how to read them as PyTorch tensors.
